description: Nova Orbit is an independent team from Pakistan participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our interests include Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Python, and Web Development. We aim to explore NASA satellite datasets and develop an interactive solution for understanding and analyzing fire hotspots using data-driven techniques.
summary: FireSight is a next-generation global wildfire intelligence platform built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge to solve critical data discrepancies in active fire monitoring. Traditional satellite data suffers from resolution gaps between NASA’s MODIS (1km grid resolution) and VIIRS (375m high-resolution) sensors, leading to fragmented early-warning insights across international borders. FireSight bridges this gap through an automated Python harmonization backend (`harmonizer.py`) that performs radiometric calibration, normalizes confidence metrics to a unified 0-100% scale, and processes real-time telemetry across 150+ global regions. The data feeds directly into a high-performance, macOS-inspired interactive React dashboard featuring dual-mode OpenStreetMap/Satellite views, dynamic multi-sensor filtering, and a collapsible telemetry HUD. By unifying fragmented data streams into a single reliable interface, FireSight empowers disaster management teams, local authorities, and researchers worldwide with precise, high-fidelity spatial intelligence for rapid wildfire response and mitigation.
details:
• What it does & How it works: FireSight is a next-generation global wildfire intelligence platform designed to eliminate cross-sensor data discrepancies in active fire monitoring. It ingests telemetry from NASA’s MODIS (1km resolution) and VIIRS (375m resolution) sensors and processes them through an automated Python harmonization backend (`harmonizer.py`). This backend normalizes disparate spatial resolutions and brightness temperatures into a unified confidence and temperature scale. The data is rendered on a high-performance React dashboard (`FireDashboard.jsx`) featuring instant search across 150+ countries, sensor-specific filtering, dual map/satellite view toggling, and a live telemetry HUD.

• Benefits & Impact: Solves international border data gaps, provides instant situational awareness for emergency responders, and unifies fragmented satellite telemetry into an intuitive spatial platform.

• Tools & Technologies Used: Python, React, Vite, React-Leaflet GIS mapping, JSON.

• Creativity & Design Considerations: Built with a modern glassmorphic interface, edge-to-edge full-screen map, and seamless mobile responsiveness to ensure high usability during high-stress disaster management scenarios.
